bns:Component.name: Produce_P2P_ErrorQueueEvent
bns:Component.bns:description: Event Streams Produce operation for Central_Error_Handler (resilience redesign 2026-09-28, mirrors Produce_P2P_ExecutionLog_Event). Publishes to topic "edv.transactions.error" the same JSON shape ErrorQueue_Insert_V2_Request_JSON expects (transaction_id, error_type, error_code, error_message, status) - Central_Error_Handler no longer writes to EDV_INTEGRATION.ERROR_QUEUE directly; Sub_ErrorQueue_Consumer drains this topic and does the actual insert. producerAccessMode=Shared because every interface's error path may produce concurrently. The "TransactionId" messageProperties slot is defined blank here and bound dynamically at the process step - best-effort tagging only, same caveat as Produce_P2P_ExecutionLog_Event re: partition/ordering guarantees. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
